captions.text: This is Parametric Studio, on your own GPU.
What's new: one clip becomes a whole shoot in a single queue,
and every result keeps the exact ComfyUI graph and seed that made it.
For Cinematic Studio, direct a shot like a film set, or queue a whole shoot on the Shot Board.
Seven jobs on one clip took about thirteen minutes.
Re-shoot a video: Reshoot makes a new take of your clip with a new camera move, on MiniMax H3.
Openjutsu, swap a character in a video: Recast keeps the performance, camera and sound,
and changes the person.
The Swap page lists every swap graph in the repo, with its render and licence.
In the VFX workflow, LTX-2.5 is the core video model.
Each effect adds one Lightricks IC-LoRA: water, a clean plate, day to night, a matte,
transitions, and LTX Finish for HDR masters.
How it's built: the apps run real ComfyUI graphs on your local ComfyUI server,
and the graph you open in 3D is the graph that runs.
The studio is FastAPI and Preact, with no build step.
We audited every one of our custom nodes,
and the Pool 51 node packs are pinned to checked commits.
Open weights, run locally, at zero credits.
It works on your phone too, with your GPU doing the work.
Next: swap one stage when a new model lands, and carry the proof inside every file.
Parametric Studio.
